\section[(dialogue)]{Food and nature — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R108-first-pass-food-and-nature}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the chest and the waist.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item rice pilaf, a thick soup, a watermelon, a melon, a peach
  \item an apricot, cherries, a date, a pomegranate, a walnut
  \item an almond, a pistachio, a cucumber, an aubergine, garlic
  \item ginger, pepper, coffee, a sweet drink, a plain
  \item a hill, an island, a waterfall, a wave, a root
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Rice pilaf? (\textbf{\fa{پلو}}, \emph{polow}.) A thick soup? (\textbf{\fa{آش}}, \emph{âsh}.) A watermelon? (\textbf{\fa{هندوانه}}, \emph{hendevâne}.) A melon? (\textbf{\fa{خربزه}}, \emph{kharboze}.) A peach? (\textbf{\fa{هلو}}, \emph{holu}.) An apricot? (\textbf{\fa{زردآلو}}, \emph{zardâlu}.) Cherries? (\textbf{\fa{گیلاس}}, \emph{gilâs}.) A date? (\textbf{\fa{خرما}}, \emph{khormâ}.) A pomegranate? (\textbf{\fa{انار}}, \emph{anâr}.) A walnut? (\textbf{\fa{گردو}}, \emph{gerdu}.) An almond? (\textbf{\fa{بادام}}, \emph{bâdâm}.) A pistachio? (\textbf{\fa{پسته}}, \emph{peste}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{\fa{خیار}}, \emph{khiyâr}.) An aubergine? (\textbf{\fa{بادمجان}}, \emph{bâdemjân}.) Garlic? (\textbf{\fa{سیر}}, \emph{sir}.) Ginger? (\textbf{\fa{زنجبیل}}, \emph{zanjabil}.) Pepper? (\textbf{\fa{فلفل}}, \emph{felfel}.) Coffee? (\textbf{\fa{قهوه}}, \emph{ghahve}.) A sweet drink? (\textbf{\fa{شربت}}, \emph{sharbat}.) A plain? (\textbf{\fa{دشت}}, \emph{dasht}.) A hill? (\textbf{\fa{تپه}}, \emph{tappe}.) An island? (\textbf{\fa{جزیره}}, \emph{jazire}.) A waterfall? (\textbf{\fa{آبشار}}, \emph{âbshâr}.) A wave? (\textbf{\fa{موج}}, \emph{mowj}.) A root? (\textbf{\fa{ریشه}}, \emph{rishe}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Nature, animals and the body — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R108-second-pass-nature-animals-and-the-body}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a seed and grass.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a seed, grass, a storm, fog, dew
  \item a leopard, a rabbit, a deer, a fox, a pig
  \item a parrot, a pigeon, a peacock, a duck, a bee
  \item a mosquito, a fly, the chin, a cheek, an elbow
  \item a wrist, a thumb, a fingernail, the chest, the waist
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A seed? (\textbf{\fa{دانه}}, \emph{dâne}.) Grass? (\textbf{\fa{سبزه}}, \emph{sabze}.) A storm? (\textbf{\fa{توفان}}, \emph{tufân}.) Fog? (\textbf{\fa{مه}}, \emph{meh}.) Dew? (\textbf{\fa{شبنم}}, \emph{shabnam}.) A leopard? (\textbf{\fa{پلنگ}}, \emph{palang}.) A rabbit? (\textbf{\fa{خرگوش}}, \emph{khargush}.) A deer? (\textbf{\fa{آهو}}, \emph{âhu}.) A fox? (\textbf{\fa{روباه}}, \emph{rubâh}.) A pig? (\textbf{\fa{خوک}}, \emph{khuk}.) A parrot? (\textbf{\fa{طوطی}}, \emph{tuti}.) A pigeon? (\textbf{\fa{کبوتر}}, \emph{kabutar}.) A peacock? (\textbf{\fa{طاووس}}, \emph{tâvus}.) A duck? (\textbf{\fa{اردک}}, \emph{ordak}.) A bee? (\textbf{\fa{زنبور}}, \emph{zanbur}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{\fa{پشه}}, \emph{pashe}.) A fly? (\textbf{\fa{مگس}}, \emph{magas}.) The chin? (\textbf{\fa{چانه}}, \emph{châne}.) A cheek? (\textbf{\fa{گونه}}, \emph{gune}.) An elbow? (\textbf{\fa{آرنج}}, \emph{âranj}.) A wrist? (\textbf{\fa{مچ}}, \emph{moch}.) A thumb? (\textbf{\fa{شست}}, \emph{shast}.) A fingernail? (\textbf{\fa{ناخن}}, \emph{nâkhon}.) The chest? (\textbf{\fa{سینه}}, \emph{sine}.) The waist? (\textbf{\fa{کمر}}, \emph{kamar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
